newsitem.title: FRANCE: Rexrodt says gold revaluation could happen this yr.
newsitem.headline: Rexrodt says gold revaluation could happen this yr.

text.p: Economy minister Guenter Rexrodt said on Monday that Germany could proceed with its plan to change the value of its gold reserves this year, but that a lot depended on the attitude of the central bank, the Bundesbank.
Asked whether the plan to revalue Germany's gold reserves could take place in 1997 or 1998, Rexrodt said: "It is possible this year, but that depends on an assessment from the Bundesbank."
He was speaking to reporters at the OECD's annual ministerial meeting in Paris.
"My opinion is that we can proceed and we should proceed," he said. "There is space for such a revaluation and it is a serious measure."
